CREATE TABLE lakehouse.bronze.customer
WITH (format='PARQUET', compression_codec='ZSTD') AS
SELECT custkey, mktsegment FROM tpch.sf1.customer

CREATE TABLE lakehouse.bronze.orders
WITH (format='PARQUET', compression_codec='ZSTD') AS
SELECT orderkey, custkey, orderdate, shippriority FROM tpch.sf1.orders

CREATE TABLE lakehouse.bronze.lineitem
WITH (format='PARQUET', compression_codec='ZSTD') AS
SELECT orderkey, extendedprice, discount, shipdate FROM tpch.sf1.lineitem

SELECT 'customer_duplicate_keys' AS check_name, count(*) AS violations
FROM (SELECT custkey FROM lakehouse.bronze.customer GROUP BY custkey HAVING count(*) > 1)
UNION ALL
SELECT 'orders_duplicate_keys', count(*)
FROM (SELECT orderkey FROM lakehouse.bronze.orders GROUP BY orderkey HAVING count(*) > 1)
UNION ALL
SELECT 'customer_invalid', count(*) FROM lakehouse.bronze.customer
WHERE custkey IS NULL OR custkey <= 0 OR mktsegment IS NULL OR trim(mktsegment) = ''
UNION ALL
SELECT 'orders_invalid', count(*) FROM lakehouse.bronze.orders
WHERE orderkey IS NULL OR orderkey <= 0 OR custkey IS NULL OR custkey <= 0
 OR orderdate IS NULL OR shippriority IS NULL OR shippriority < 0
UNION ALL
SELECT 'lineitem_invalid', count(*) FROM lakehouse.bronze.lineitem
WHERE orderkey IS NULL OR orderkey <= 0 OR extendedprice IS NULL OR extendedprice < 0
 OR NOT is_finite(extendedprice) OR discount IS NULL OR discount < 0 OR discount > 1
 OR NOT is_finite(discount) OR shipdate IS NULL
UNION ALL
SELECT 'orders_orphans', count(*) FROM lakehouse.bronze.orders o
LEFT JOIN lakehouse.bronze.customer c ON o.custkey = c.custkey WHERE c.custkey IS NULL
UNION ALL
SELECT 'lineitem_orphans', count(*) FROM lakehouse.bronze.lineitem l
LEFT JOIN lakehouse.bronze.orders o ON l.orderkey = o.orderkey WHERE o.orderkey IS NULL
UNION ALL
SELECT 'segment_normalization_changes', count(*) FROM lakehouse.bronze.customer
WHERE mktsegment <> upper(trim(mktsegment))
SELECT count(*), to_hex(checksum(ROW(custkey, mktsegment))) FROM tpch.sf1.customer
SELECT count(*), to_hex(checksum(ROW(custkey, mktsegment))) FROM lakehouse.bronze.customer
SELECT count(*), to_hex(checksum(ROW(orderkey, custkey, orderdate, shippriority))) FROM tpch.sf1.orders
SELECT count(*), to_hex(checksum(ROW(orderkey, custkey, orderdate, shippriority))) FROM lakehouse.bronze.orders
SELECT count(*), to_hex(checksum(ROW(orderkey, extendedprice, discount, shipdate))) FROM tpch.sf1.lineitem
SELECT count(*), to_hex(checksum(ROW(orderkey, extendedprice, discount, shipdate))) FROM lakehouse.bronze.lineitem

CREATE TABLE lakehouse.silver.shipping_order_lines
WITH (format='PARQUET', compression_codec='ZSTD') AS
SELECT l.orderkey, o.orderdate, o.shippriority, l.shipdate,
       l.extendedprice, l.discount,
       l.extendedprice * (1 - l.discount) AS line_revenue,
       upper(trim(c.mktsegment)) AS mktsegment
FROM lakehouse.bronze.customer c
JOIN lakehouse.bronze.orders o ON c.custkey = o.custkey
JOIN lakehouse.bronze.lineitem l ON l.orderkey = o.orderkey
WHERE c.mktsegment = 'BUILDING'
  AND o.orderdate < DATE '1995-03-15'
  AND l.shipdate > DATE '1995-03-15'

CREATE TABLE lakehouse.gold.shipping_priority
WITH (format='PARQUET', compression_codec='ZSTD') AS
SELECT orderkey, sum(line_revenue) AS revenue, orderdate, shippriority
FROM lakehouse.silver.shipping_order_lines
GROUP BY orderkey, orderdate, shippriority
ORDER BY revenue DESC
LIMIT 10
